title: [JAC-4533-S2] Add privacy fields to createCostEventSchema Zod validator
description:
Implement Step 2 of the JAC-4533 plan: extend `createCostEventSchema` in `packages/shared/src/validators/cost.ts` to accept and validate all 9 privacy/retention fields (visibility_class, retention_class, redaction_state, source_permission_ref, tenant_ref_hash, subject_ref_hashes, source_deleted_at, tombstone_ref, policy_version).

**Plan reference:** doc/plans/2026-08-04-jac-4533-privacy-retention-schema-fields.md, Section 5, Step 2
**Parent:** JAC-4533 [JAC-3929] P1: Privacy/retention first-class schema fields
**Status:** planning
**Depends on:** Step 1 (cost_events privacy index)
**Blocks:** Step 5 (createEvent service), Step 9 (tests)

**Scope:**
- Add Zod enum fields for visibility_class, retention_class, redaction_state with fail-closed defaults
- Add nullable fields for source_permission_ref, tenant_ref_hash, subject_ref_hashes, source_deleted_at, tombstone_ref, policy_version
- Add transform that validates tenant_ref_hash and subject_ref_hashes elements as SHA-256 hex (^[a-f0-9]{64}$)
- Constants (VISIBILITY_CLASSES, RETENTION_CLASSES, REDACTION_STATES) already imported but unused — wire them in

**Verification:**
- Zod schema rejects invalid enum values
- SHA-256 hex format enforced for hash fields
- Defaults resolve to internal/standard/unredacted when omitted

title: [JAC-4533-S7] Update heartbeat.ts callers to pass privacy fields
description:
Implement Step 7 of the JAC-4533 plan: update heartbeat.ts callers of createRunEvent() to pass privacy fields. For normal Paperclip adapter runs, the defaults (internal/standard/unredacted) are appropriate, but the service layer should derive sourcePermissionRef from the agent's permission context, tenantRefHash from the company's tenant context (for multi-tenant), and policyVersion from the company's current privacy policy version.

**Plan reference:** doc/plans/2026-08-04-jac-4533-privacy-retention-schema-fields.md, Section 5, Step 7
**Parent:** JAC-4533 [JAC-3929] P1: Privacy/retention first-class schema fields
**Status:** planning
**Depends on:** Steps 4-6
**Blocks:** Step 9 (tests)

**Scope:**
- File: server/src/services/heartbeat.ts (lines 11770-11781, 14319-14331)
- Pass through privacy fields from the run context if available
- Derive sourcePermissionRef from agent permission context
- Derive tenantRefHash from company tenant context (for multi-tenant deployments)
- Derive policyVersion from company's current privacy policy version

**Verification:**
- Heartbeat callers pass privacy fields to createRunEvent()
- Default values (internal/standard/unredacted) applied when no context available

title: [JAC-4533-S8] Add validation + fail-closed enforcement in API routes
description:
Implement Step 8 of the JAC-4533 plan: add fail-closed enforcement in API routes. The Zod validation (Steps 2-3) already enforces the value sets. Add a server-side guard: reject visibility_class = public from external (non-board) actors unless a publish_full_artifact-style approval exists on the issue.

**Plan reference:** doc/plans/2026-08-04-jac-4533-privacy-retention-schema-fields.md, Section 5, Step 8
**Parent:** JAC-4533 [JAC-3929] P1: Privacy/retention first-class schema fields
**Status:** planning
**Depends on:** Steps 2-3, 4-5
**Blocks:** Step 9 (tests)

**Scope:**
- File: server/src/routes/costs.ts
- POST /companies/:companyId/run-events — clamp visibility_class to internal for non-board actors
- POST /companies/:companyId/cost-events — same enforcement
- Activity log entries for rejected visibility escalations

**Verification:**
- External adapter (bearer token) submitting visibility_class=public is clamped to internal or rejected
- Board actor can still set public visibility
- Activity log records enforcement actions
